osmchange_menu_hint: An osmChange file (.osc), for example from Go Map!! or JOSM, merged with the current map data
osmchange_empty: No file loaded. Load an osmChange file (.osc) from the account menu at the right of the top bar.
osmchange_loading: Reading {file} and asking the server for the current data…
osmchange_conflict_nodes: Both changed the nodes of the way at the same place
osmchange_conflict_delete_changed: Changed on the server since the file's version
osmchange_note_moved_close: Both moved it, {metres} m apart: took the file's position
osmchange_note_server_nodes: Kept the server's nodes of the way
osmchange_note_nodes_merged: Merged the changes of both to the nodes of the way
osmchange_note_deleted_on_server: Deleted on the server since; the file's change is left out
osmchange_note_already_applied: The server already has this state
osmchange_note_no_base: Version {version} could not be read from the history, so every difference is a decision
osmchange_note_no_version: The file gives no version, so every difference is a decision
osmchange_error_xml: The file is not valid XML.
osmchange_error_not_osmchange: This is not an osmChange file.
osmchange_error_element: The file has an unknown element <{name}>.
osmchange_error_id: A {type} in the file has no valid id.
osmchange_error_create_id: {id} is created with a positive id.
osmchange_error_existing_id: {id} is changed or deleted with a negative id.
osmchange_error_tag: A tag of {id} has no key or no value.
osmchange_error_reference: {id} refers to an element without a valid id.
osmchange_error_way_nodes: The way {id} has fewer than two nodes.
osmchange_error_new_reference: {id} is used but not created by the file.
osmchange_error_too_many: The file has more than {max} elements, the most the OSM API takes in one changeset.
osmchange_error_local_edits: You changed {ids} here and have not saved it. Save or undo that first, then load the file.
osmchange_error_stale: The map shows an older version of {ids} than the server. Reload the page, then load the file.
osmchange_error_missing: The file uses {ids}, which is not on the server.
osmchange_error_fetch: The server could not be asked: {reason}
osmchange_changeset_comment: Changes from {from}, merged with the current map in Maid
osmchange_intro_clear: Changes without conflicts are in the editor already, as one undo step.
osmchange_intro_decide: A decision takes effect as soon as you click it.
osmchange_intro_undo: Undo takes changes back; Save uploads them as usual.
osmchange_note_already_created: Already on the server as {id}: not created again
osmchange_undone: The changes from this file were undone. Load the file again to decide.
